# Generated by tools/build_duels.py. Fighter scope.
ac_duel_can_unleash_trigger = {
	NOT = { has_variable = ac_duel_tech_used }
	ac_chi_available >= 1
	OR = {
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_wrathful_fist
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_inferno
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_shockblast
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_arctic_pillar
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_blade_barrier
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_seismic_closing_palms
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_grand_skyfall
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_imbued_bodyhammer
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_midnight_blade
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_searing_light
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_tenebrous_rift
		has_character_flag = ac_tech_daggerfalling_hailstorm
	}
}
